description: This PHP class defines the PoolPaymentMethod, a payment method that utilizes an internal virtual wallet (pool) for processing payments within the Goteo platform. It includes methods for checking pool status, processing purchases, refunds, and related functionalities.

classes.name: PoolPaymentMethod
classes.description: A payment method class that handles internal virtual wallet transactions, using Omnipay manual method for processing payments within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: getGatewayName
methods.description: Returns the name of the payment gateway, which is 'Manual' for this method.

methods.name: getPool
methods.description: Retrieves the user's pool object, initializing it if not already set.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the payment method is active based on the user's pool amount and the specified amount.

methods.name: getDesc
methods.description: Provides a description of the pool amount available for investment.

methods.name: purchase
methods.description: Completes the purchase by withdrawing the amount from the pool and initiating the payment authorization.

methods.name: refundable
methods.description: Determines if the investment is eligible for refund based on its status.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Processes the refund, dispatching an event and marking the investment for return to the pool.

methods.name: isInternal
methods.description: Indicates that this payment method is internal, not increasing raised amounts outside the pool.
